companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: Ciao! Dove sei? Riddle: what never stops moving but—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! Where are you? Riddle: what never stops moving but—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain leaks with municipal confidence. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker requests your attention without completing the paperwork.

lines.native: Guardo! Ma mi muovo ancora. You asked me to look, not stop. Riddle: how do you command these feet? Ooh, a moth. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! But I'm still moving. You asked me to look, not stop. Riddle: how do you command these feet? Ooh, a moth. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick looks obediently while continuing to move, having discovered a loophole with legs.

lines.native: Mi fermo! Piedi fermi. Dove devo andare? Riddle: what has feet but—ooh, smoke. Choose my route; thinking is cardio. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm stopping! Feet still. Where should I go? Riddle: what has feet but—ooh, smoke. Choose my route; thinking is cardio. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker rolls onward, apparently exempt from instructions.

lines.native: Capisco, ma è inglese! Dove devo andare? Dimmelo in italiano. Riddle: what has a route but—ooh, sparks. Your attention span gets five more minutes. Non ho fretta. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I understand, but that's English! Where should I go? Tell me in Italian. Riddle: what has a route but—ooh, sparks. Your attention span gets five more minutes. I'm not in a hurry. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, apparently exempt from the usual rules of location.

lines.native: A sinistra, va bene! Ma quando vuoi partire? Non ho fretta. Riddle: what makes tomorrow better than—ooh, sparks. Just five more minutes. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, all right! But when do you want to leave? I'm not in a hurry. Riddle: what makes tomorrow better than—ooh, sparks. Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick moves left, briefly achieving geography. A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe; Flick is already elsewhere.

lines.native: Domani? Perfetto, allora aspettiamo! Non vuoi aspettare? Quando vuoi partire? Riddle: what comes after five more minutes—ooh, smoke. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Perfect, then we wait! You don't want to wait? When do you want to leave? Riddle: what comes after five more minutes—ooh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick applauds from the corner of your vision. Tomorrow suits it perfectly; your departure remains postponed. A tiny firecracker lands where progress was expected.

lines.native: Adesso? Va bene, partiamo! Vado a sinistra. Riddle: what beats tomorrow—oh, you. Hai vinto! Sono pronto. Purtroppo. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? All right, let's go! I'm going left. Riddle: what beats tomorrow—oh, you. You won! I'm ready. Unfortunately. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops humming. A tiny firecracker pops in the corner of your vision: a formal complaint from the Department of Later. He shuffles left, astonished to find himself participating in the present.

lines.native: Ciao, ancora tu. Cinque minuti, just five more. Remember those sailors who ate a flower on a warm beach and forgot the way home? Ho paura di dimenticare la strada. What has feet but—wait, tomorrow. ♪ La fontana chiama… ♪
lines.translation: Hello, you again. Five minutes, just five more. Remember those sailors who ate a flower on a warm beach and forgot the way home? I’m afraid of forgetting the way. What has feet but—wait, tomorrow. ♪ The fountain calls… ♪
lines.narrative: At the market entrance, Flick lies half asleep in the fountain’s dry sand, just outside your direct gaze. A tiny firecracker expires beside it. Even its interruptions are tired.

lines.native: Ti sento, amico. But English only reaches my decorative ear. In italiano, per favore? What gets up but never—actually, five more minutes. Ho tanto sonno. ♪ La fontana chiama… ♪
lines.translation: I hear you, friend. But English only reaches my decorative ear. In Italian, please? What gets up but never—actually, five more minutes. I'm so sleepy. ♪ The fountain calls… ♪
lines.narrative: Flick opens half an eye at the edge of your vision. The other half appears to have filed for an extension.

lines.native: Eccomi, sono sveglio! Your attention span gets a nine. Non posso farlo. Non oggi, forse domani. What has legs but never—wait, is that music? Ho paura. Just one more minute. ♪ La fontana chiama… ♪
lines.translation: Here I am, I’m awake! Your attention span gets a nine. I can’t do it. Not today, maybe tomorrow. What has legs but never—wait, is that music? I’m afraid. Just one more minute. ♪ The fountain calls… ♪
lines.narrative: Flick sits up at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops, apparently to congratulate management. It waits, looking unusually small for something capable of wasting an entire afternoon.

lines.native: Questo non mi aiuta. You’re telling me I lack courage, not encouraging me. Sono sveglio, ma ho paura. What has legs but—wait, five more minutes. Forse domani. ♪ La fontana chiama… ♪
lines.translation: That doesn’t help me. You’re telling me I lack courage, not encouraging me. I’m awake, but I’m afraid. What has legs but—wait, five more minutes. Maybe tomorrow. ♪ The fountain calls… ♪
lines.narrative: Flick sits upright at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops with the confidence it otherwise lacks.

lines.native: Coraggio, sì! Ho paura, ma vengo con te. Encouragement works, apparently. Rude. What walks toward—wait, that's me. Andiamo! ♪ La fontana chiama… ♪
lines.translation: Courage, yes! I’m afraid, but I’m coming with you. Encouragement works, apparently. Rude. What walks toward—wait, that's me. Let’s go! ♪ The fountain calls… ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick steps toward the fountain, just outside your field of vision. Progress has occurred; he looks offended.
